venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: High 90s — hot and humid, heatwave continues
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 7/2 (MOD MKZ // JK):** Steady start with 15 Meal Deals to open. A lull around 6–7pm, then it picked up at 8pm with folks out before the holiday weekend and watching Portugal vs Croatia. Large groups in for drinks, and a guest got proposed to in the park across the street — the couple (Brooke & Patrick) popped in with friends and got a celebratory round. Stayed steady until ~11pm when industry friends joined. Opener cut ~7pm, one closing bartender cut at 10:30. One of the better Thursdays in a while — likely helped by the short holiday weekend. Kitchen ran smooth ticket times; 86'd wings (back tomorrow, marinating overnight). Net $3,237 vs $6,484 target; 108 guests, $29.81 check avg; food $467, comps $97.70. (Typeform logged $3,220 net; MOD posted a corrected $3,237.)

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 7/2 (MOD KK/KE/KM, Chef Kevin):** Great start with incredible food sales — Brandon C held ~45% food sales until a big rush around 9:30pm. With many guests likely off Friday, a solid push came in to celebrate. Two decent-size parties: a bridal shower and a going-away for a friend moving to Minneapolis, driving a great vibe throughout. Kitchen door repair is COMPLETE; Froster 3 still down. 86'd Guinness draft until tomorrow. Net $4,226 vs $3,424 target (+23.4%); ~147 guests, $28.75 check avg; food $339, comps $128.35 (3.03%).

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 7/2 (AM Evan/Josh, PM Maggie/Lucas):** Chill Thursday, nothing crazy. Café service was a breeze; fresh batches of evergreen, miel, mocha and caramel. Garden stayed full while the lobby stayed chill, with the usual late pop at 9:30 — no wait lists. DC/AM $765, D&C (PM) $10,650.09, Garden/6A $3,378.53; total net $11,415.98 vs $15,932.92 target. Food $1,955, comps $224 (normals), 200 guests. Maintenance: fridge behind Marquee (0500) froze — product moved to 0300 fridge, some exploded N/A products tossed. Great energy across all teams.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 7/2 (MOD Cara & Steves):** Day 2 of the heat wave, into the 100s. Siesta-like open with 10 covers in the first hour, mostly regulars/book aficionados. Only broached $2.4k by 10pm — the latter half of service provided the squeeze. Most 8pm reservations cancelled for a slim turn, but all 10pm reservations came early with a big turn, everyone sat by 9:50pm. Steady walk-in flow after, properly full by 10:30 and bumping until 11:30, with a late 6-top and 4-top at 1am. 3 solos, 2 large parties, 138 covers. Top sellers: Rosalie, Native Lion, Paper Wasp. Net $5,153 vs $7,569 target; beverage $4,687, food $440, retail $26; $37 check avg, comps $74.24.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 7/2 (MOD Gigi, Chef Saleh/Vic):** A tame evening that turned into quite the night — after 9pm the pace picked up dramatically, turn-and-burn with a 40–50 deep waitlist all night. Short-handed but the team pushed through; lots of 2-tops and large groups. Michael was in visiting from Denver to observe service, meet the team and share wisdom. Strong last call for both food and drinks; streets were wild after the night's sporting events. Marquee $7,221 (food $971); net $7,221 vs $6,278 target (+15.0%); 198 guests, $93.28 check avg, comps $148. Maintenance: oven knob, walk-in light out (bulb tomorrow).

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Heat advisory — slow foot traffic until sundown
venues.narrative: **DCDC — Thursday 7/2 (MOD Marcus):** Good night despite extreme heat slowing early foot traffic (stairwell/garden heat deterred some guests). Full room around 8:30pm and another nice wave ~10:45pm. Glizz & Glam Remix was very well received — Chef James executed the specials alongside the regular menu, with a shout-out to Chef Josh's crab dip. Devan managed the door well, pacing resos into the A/C efficiently. Marquee $4,646.38 net, garden $0; net $4,646.38 vs $6,898.05 target; food $613.20, comps $52.95; 110 guests (40 resos / 70 walk-ins), $42.24 avg. Maintenance: ice machine pooling, curtains off rails, service-entrance flooring, stairwell/garden heat.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG F&B — Thursday 7/2 (AM Justin/Lex, PM Braden/Shannon):** Slow weekday morning doable by one server (11 covers, $505). Slow evening (108 covers, $5,281) with sporadic guests and never a full turn — cut mid server at 7 and host at 9; no barback strained the bar as glass piled up after the SA was cut ~9. Sun Club slow ($651). Hot Eye ($1,240) slow but steady — a nice mix of out-of-towners, local regulars and industry, with lots of birthdays; the room was muggy and a palmetto bug visited. Kitchen smooth; a stage cooked during a small 7:30–8:30 pop, and downtime went to prepping weekend specials. Net $7,183 vs $8,000 target; food $2,107, comps $125. Maintenance: pest control to THE. Lots of glassware lost.
